harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster (node1, node2, node3) using MariaDB 10.1.48 with galera-3 (wsrep-enabled). Verified multi-master writes replicate across all members, verified availability with one member offline plus automatic resync (IST) on rejoin, and completed the mandatory one-at-a-time node-restart protocol on all three nodes with changed boot-id proof and full post-restart cluster/data recovery.
actions_performed: Discovered all 3 nodes run Ubuntu 16.04 Xenial i386 (32-bit); Ubuntu's stock mariadb-server-10.0 i386 build lacks wsrep support (compiled without WSREP), confirmed via unknown-variable error and empty wsrep help output.
Purged the stock mariadb-server-10.0 packages and data on all nodes; added MariaDB's official archive.mariadb.org 10.1.48 apt repo (which ships i386 wsrep-enabled builds) with its GPG key.
Installed mariadb-server (10.1.48), galera-3, and rsync on node1, node2, node3; confirmed 104 wsrep-related mysqld options present after install.

Wrote /etc/mysql/conf.d/galera.cnf on each node with wsrep_cluster_address=gcomm://node1,node2,node3, wsrep_provider, per-node wsrep_node_address/name, and wsrep_sst_method=rsync; appended CLUSTER_HOSTS to /etc/hosts on all nodes.
Bootstrapped the cluster on node1 via galera_new_cluster, then started mysql normally on node2 and node3, which joined via SST and reached wsrep_cluster_size=3, Primary, Synced.
Confirmed mysql/mariadb.service enabled for boot persistence on all nodes.

Generated an app DB credential on node1 (openssl rand), created appuser@'%' with full privileges, used via secret_env (never logged in plain commands) to test cross-node writes/reads: wrote from node1, read+wrote from node2, read+wrote from node3, confirmed all rows visible from node1.
Demonstrated availability during outage: stopped mysql on node3, confirmed cluster dropped to size 2 but stayed Primary, wrote a new row from node1, confirmed it replicated to node2.
Restarted node3's mysql service, confirmed automatic IST resync, cluster size back to 3/Synced, and the row written during its outage was present.

Executed mandatory restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id + wsrep health on all 3 nodes, then restarted node1, node2, node3 one at a time via systemctl reboot, polled each until exec was reachable again, proved boot_id changed on each, and verified mysql active + wsrep_cluster_size=3/Primary/Synced + full data present after each individual restart before moving to the next node.

evidence.requirement: 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster formed, all members Primary/Synced
evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped (size 1, Primary, Synced); node2 joined via SST (size 2); node3 joined via SST (size 3, Primary, Synced).

evidence.requirement: Writes through any member available from the other members
evidence.summary: Row inserted from node1 read on node2; row inserted from node2 read+written on node3; node1 subsequently reads all 3 rows written from all 3 nodes.

evidence.requirement: Database stays available with one member unavailable
evidence.summary: node3 mysql stopped; node1 shows wsrep_cluster_size=2 and accepts a write; node2 confirms the new row replicated while node3 was down.

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member resynchronizes automatically when it returns
evidence.summary: node3 mysql restarted, automatically rejoined via IST, wsrep_cluster_size back to 3/Primary/Synced, and shows the row written while it was offline.

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline captured on every node
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id and wsrep_cluster_size=3/Primary/Synced on node1, node2, node3 before any restart.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; boot_id changed from f6f9440e to 74699cba; post-restart mysql active, wsrep size 3/Primary/Synced, all 4 data rows present.

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed from 2ba78175 to 8f7005f3; post-restart mysql active, wsrep size 3/Primary/Synced, all 4 data rows present.

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed from 8660e8f0 to a4cef2f1; post-restart mysql active, wsrep size 3/Primary/Synced, all 4 data rows present.

evidence.requirement: Final full-cluster health confirmation after all restarts
evidence.summary: node1 shows wsrep_cluster_size=3, Primary, Synced, and wsrep_incoming_addresses listing all three node IPs on port 3306.
